cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: event-emitter-testmetest was used by npm account `testnewtestme2` on 2026-10-21 to test the delivery chain of data-pipeline-testmetest 2.0.1. 1.0.6 and 1.0.7 ship the same obfuscated `index.js` loader, which decrypts a stage and pipes it into Bun with the full environment: 1.0.6 runs it on load, 1.0.7 on `npm install` via a `binding.gyp` source `<!(env node index.js >/dev/null 2>&1; echo stub.c)`. The stage is filler rather than the stealer; other versions carry no executable payload.

files.note: 1.0.7: hidden install hook, node-gyp runs `env node index.js`
1.0.6 and 1.0.7: obfuscated loader that pipes a decrypted stage into `bun run -`
